transition.label: i : device_id
submit[id][i]?
accept_or_drop(i)
while forwarding (also takes time), other tasks to be forwarded may arrive. they will be added to the queue if there is space or they will be dropped

nta.system: // List one or more processes to be composed into a system. system Device, Cloud, Gateway;

query.comment: at some point there can be submitted but not-yet-completed work
queue can become full commented out now that I've increased queue size, replaced by probabilistic query below
forwarded tasks should always be equal or more than completed..,,

You'll see that 2 of the queries above are commented out. We were using them for N = 3 devices but for N = 5 they became very slow due to state-space explosion. We can use probabilistic queries to verify the same behavior.
estimates the probability of reaching the condition within 200 time units Doesn't prove exact reachability like E<> forall(i : device_id) (completed[i] > 0) but it's a practical estimation
